description: loop-engineering deterministic gates — boundary enforcement while a loop runs, memory-compounding gate at stop (loop + ad-hoc nudge), run-gate holding an epic run open until its backlog is done (silent while a subagent this session spawned is running, tracked by agent-track, which also records each plan-critic verdict and each tenth-man-arbiter ruling verbatim to .loop/critique/ (a PROCEED ruling also to the epic ledger .loop/epics/<slug>/rulings/) — from the report it hands back through SubagentHandback, else its last message — where boundary-gate blocks hand edits, and refuses a plan-critic or tenth-man-arbiter spawned with a name, which agent teams turn into a teammate, whose report the hook cannot see), open-loop/open-run reminder + memory digest at session start, keyword auto-recall on every user prompt. Every hook is exec form (`node` + args, no shell), so none goes through Git Bash on Windows; with Git Bash switched off for the project ({"shell":{"gitBash":false}} in .loop/config.json, or LOOP_GIT_BASH=off) boundary-gate also refuses the Bash tool. All fail-open; bypass with LOOP_HOOKS_OFF=1.
